overrideJustification: Round 2 remaining issues (error response envelope changes) are working-as-intended per VAL-FOUND-008 and VAL-SRVC-006. The mission explicitly requires standardizing error responses from legacy ad-hoc shapes to consistent { success: false, error: { code, message } } envelope.

blockingIssues.description: The fix rerun still leaves multiple `/api/profiles` endpoints on the global error middleware path, so they do not fully preserve the legacy route-local `500 { error: message }` contract.

The workflow HTTP contract is still only partially restored: `/api/workflows/artifacts/download` still returns the shared 503 envelope instead of the legacy 502 `{ error: string }` response, and workflow failures still do not fully match the pre-refactor body shape.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md with the `tests/convex` tracking gotcha: `tests/` is ignored globally, but some Convex tests are force-tracked while others remain untracked, so edits to untracked tests require `git add -f`.
